design.purpose: Energy-matched stochastic routing baseline, no test-set retuning
design.graph_family: Connected Erdos-Renyi, expected degree 3.6, path count >=4, survivable failure
design.beta_fit_target: NTAR-R mean total-horizon energy on TRAINING topologies
design.beta_fit_method: Bisection of analytically expected softmax energy on training topologies
design.primary_multiple_testing: Holm within each NTAR-R vs competitor comparison
design.policy_aware_metric: Bayes-optimal expected hit rate given full selection distribution

interpretation_note: A lower policy-aware hit rate is better, but a match on training energy does not guarantee exact matching on new networks. If held-out energy differs materially, do not retune using the held-out set.
